cases.question: What is the highest eligible free rate for K-12 students in the schools in Alameda County?

cases.title: 特许学校邮编
cases.subtitle: 条件过滤：Fresno County Office of Education
cases.question: Please list the zip code of all the charter schools in Fresno County Office of Education.
cases.evidence: Charter schools refers to `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 in the table fprm

artifacts.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Zip FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND T2."District Name" = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
artifacts.revised_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Zip FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND T2."District Name" = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
artifacts.final_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Zip FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND T2."District Name" = 'Fresno County Office of Education'

cases.title: 虚拟学校统计
cases.subtitle: 多表关联：学校与 SAT 成绩
cases.question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?

artifacts.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.Virtual = 'F' AND T2.AvgScrMath > 400
artifacts.revised_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.Virtual = 'F' AND T2.AvgScrMath > 400
artifacts.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.Virtual = 'F' AND T2.AvgScrMath > 400
